Sunday funday fantasy football ranking updates! -Moved Patrick Mahomes behind Stafford/Goff. Doubting the best QB of the last 5+ years, what could go wrong! Just so little firepower to throw the football to, the offense is likely going to lean into Walker on the ground more than ever, and Mahomes has already talked about likely not running as much this year -- Something the injury sure won't help. -The more I look at the Round 1-2 RB turn, the more Chase Brown seems like the guy with the most answers. We love the offense. They throw him the ball plenty. Zero real competition for touches. Proven high-end RB1 upside. Is he as good in real life as Saquon Barkley or James Cook? No, but as we know, sometimes that doesn't win out in fantasy land. RB4 behind Gibbs, Bijan, CMC. -Whole Foods: David Montgomery. Target: Jordan Mason. Walmart: Chris Rodriguez. And hey, I fuck with Walmart! They have some real nice prices on dog toys! Not going to be targets for every build/shopping trip, but hey, sometimes that price is right. -Have Chuba Hubbard ranked one spot ahead of Jonathon Brooks. That said: My preference is for someone else to draft Chuba so that I can draft Brooks. -MarShawn Lloyd and Jaydon Blue up in the Marks/Tracy/Spears tier. If we're wrong, okay, send 'em to the waiver wire. If we're right, these are explosive, pass-catching talents in WAY better offenses. All bench stashes anyway, let's shoot for some upside! -Malik Nabers 23rd overall. WR10 and that still feels too low. -Terry McLaurin WR29 just behind DJ Moore, Stefon Diggs WR40 right there with Chris Godwin. Real winner: Jayden Daniels. Terry should be the 1A, but man he's never had target competition like this. There's *something* with the "less double teams" idea, but do think WSH is similar to TB where it's like, would we REALLY be shocked if the 1B winds up leading the team in targets? -Moved Greg Dortch ahead of Tez Johnson just to feel something in this sick, cruel world FULL RANKS are right here, can use code "IAN20" for 20% off if you're into that kind of thing: https://www.rotowire.com/football/expert-rankings/ian-hartitz
